strings.nt1s: Cyclus is not a contraceptive. Never rely on Cyclus to avoid pregnancy. You can get pregnant even on days Cyclus shows as low or no fertility. If you don’t want to get pregnant, use contraception.
strings.nt2s: Forecasts and fertile days are statistical estimates from what you enter. They can be wrong, especially with irregular cycles, after hormonal birth control, while breastfeeding or when ill.
strings.nt3s: Cyclus does not diagnose anything and does not replace medical advice. For questions or symptoms, talk to your healthcare provider.
strings.nt4s: What you do with this information is your decision. The developer is not liable for the consequences of such decisions, in particular for an unplanned pregnancy or for not getting pregnant. This does not apply to intent or gross negligence, to injury to life, body or health, or where product liability law applies.

method: Cyclus looks at the length of your recent cycles, counting the newest ones more. It shows a range where your next period is likely to start, about 8 times out of 10.
With few cycles the range is wide on purpose. It narrows as you log more.
Everything is calculated on your device. Cyclus never receives your data.
